prior_fixture_failure.fix: Validate integer or digit-only string and bounded value before exporting a normalized counter

limitations_and_next_gates: This proves a component, not a complete R35 round or a real cloud/DNS operation
Concrete initial setup authorization, data seeding and dual-source registration still require composition and full-application verification
Control DNS and certificate/TLS setup must be available before sources need their callbacks; edge record initialization follows source identity
Certificate TXT creation and provider-backed issuance are not covered by this A-record initializer
The DNS fixture uses an explicitly test-only gate, not proof of the production isolated CLI grant issuer or revocation
The initializer requires its caller to hold the exclusive controller journal lock
Lost create acknowledgement remains unresolved and blocks adoption or a second create
The node ELF used for installation component tests is synthetic and was not executed
A final provenance-verified node runtime freeze, complete lifecycle test and new live approval/preflight remain outstanding
